    -- upvalues: ShopData (copy), u17 (copy)
    local v24 = 0;

    for _, v in { p23:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"), p23.Character } do
        if v then
            for _, child in v:GetChildren() do
                if child:IsA("Tool") then
                    local v25 = ShopData.ITEMS[child.Name];
                    local v26;

                    if v25 == nil then
                        v26 = false;
                    else
                        v26 = v25.slot == "streak";
                    end;

                    if not (v26 or u17[child.Name]) then
                        v24 = v24 + 1;
                    end;
                end;
            end;
        end;
    end;

    return v24 + 1;
end;
